plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Git state in the status line, plus /ship to stage, commit and push in one step.

plugins.name: boot-guard
plugins.description: Takes a snapper snapshot before Bash commands that change dkms, kernel modules, limine, the initramfs or boot entries.

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Saves a git bundle of the repository before Bash commands that rewrite or delete git history: force pushes, filter-repo, reset --hard, branch and tag deletes.

plugins.name: liftoff
plugins.description: Watches GitHub Actions and Vercel after every push: a live row above the prompt, a notification when it ends, and the failed log handed to Claude in one press. No model calls.

plugins.name: twin
plugins.description: Keeps a public mirror in step with its private source: says when it is behind, runs the export, shows the diff, and commits with the source's message and pushes only on your word.

plugins.name: later
plugins.description: Checks Claude schedules for later, run by systemd so they outlast the session and survive a reboot: a command, a pass rule, and the verdict waiting in your next session.

plugins.name: undertaker
plugins.description: What Claude's rm deletes in your home folder goes to the Trash instead, kept 7 days and restorable with /graveyard. Refuses a delete while a program holds it.

plugins.name: crash-desk
plugins.description: Groups this machine's core dumps by signature, says when a crash is a repeat and what was found last time, and keeps crash-free timers in the status line.
